messages:
Sam: Thanks everyone for the packed all-hands. Opening this thread for security/privacy follow-ups so we don't lose items. Main asks: SOC2 evidence automation, VPC peering/playbook, audit-log retention/export, and BYOK/KMS roadmap.
Jordan: I'll drive the SOC2 evidence matrix and look into automating snapshots. Goal: first pass by Wednesday EOD.
Leah: Product team can surface any feature gaps that impact controls (e.g., route-level logging off by default). I'll collect those and prioritize.
Ravi: I'll run an inventory of recently launched routes and post a short CSV of where logging is missing.
Anna: Infra will draft the VPC peering playbook (required subnets, routes, security groups, and example Terraform). ETA: Friday.
Jordan: For audit logs, compliance requested three retention options with cost delta: 90d / 365d / 7y. I'll prepare a cost model + proposed default. Also prototyping an export to S3 with object lock + signed hashes.
Sam: Leadership preference is 365d by default unless a customer or compliance need dictates longer. Include an approx monthly cost impact per 1000 accounts.
Jordan: Plan for export script looks like this (will refine):
```
aws s3 cp /var/log/redwood/audit.log s3://redwood-compliance-exports/2026-04-01/ --object-lock-mode GOVERNANCE --storage-class STANDARD_IA
sha256sum audit.log > audit.log.sha256
aws s3 cp audit.log.sha256 s3://redwood-compliance-exports/2026-04-01/
```
Anna: We'll add lifecycle rules to move to Glacier after 90 days for the cheaper retention tiers. Note: must coordinate with Legal before enabling Object Lock in prod buckets.
Leah: On PII redaction: Product will add a guideline to redact user_pii fields before persisting to the audit stream. I'll draft a spec showing allowed vs redacted fields.
Ravi: Suggested minimal log schema: timestamp, request_id, user_id_hash, route, model_id, action, response_status, flags. Will push to the specs repo and open a PR.
Jordan: BYOK/KMS: customers want BYOK with rotation and auditability. Roadmap proposal: Q2 alpha for Dedicated/Private with KMS integrations; Q3 for hosted-managed BYOK patterns. We'll publish compatibility notes.
Sam: Include a clear statement about limitations (e.g., cross-region key usage, backup/restore constraints) and SLA expectations for key usage and rotation.
ComplianceBot: Reminder: please attach evidence artifacts (config snapshots, hashes) to the SOC2 ticket for traceability.
Anna: Quick question from infra: will hosted tenants ever be allowed to import their own keys into our tenancy?
Jordan: Short-term: no. BYOK will be supported on Dedicated and Private first. Hosted will get customer-managed keys via partner clouds later.
Ravi: Can we set up a 30-min weekly check-in for the next month to keep progress visible? Tue 9am PT work for folks?
Sam: Yes, schedule it and include the action tracker.
Leah: I'll compile a single follow-up doc with owners and attach links here when done.
Jordan: I'll post the SOC2 evidence matrix and the S3 export prototype in #eng-infra tomorrow and tag legal/compliance.
Sam: Great. Keep this thread for updates and paste links to the docs as they're created. :thumbsup:
